evidence.title: Getting Started - Supercharged Shadcn/UI Components - Supercharged Shadcn/UI Components

name: Supercharged Shadcn Components
summary: Copy-paste React component library that extends shadcn/ui with simpler type-safe forms, inputs, date and time pickers and uploads.
description: A collection of pre-designed components you copy into your project like shadcn/ui: buttons, floating input and textarea, chip, rating, autocomplete, combobox, multi select, date, date range and time pickers, single and multiple upload, and a form provider, most with React Hook Form wrappers. Integrates date-fns, framer-motion, numeral and react-hook-form.
contains: copy-paste components for React in shadcn/ui style
buttons, chip, rating, floating input and floating textarea
date picker, date range picker and time picker components
select, combobox, autocomplete and multi select
React Hook Form wrappers for the form components
integrates date-fns, framer-motion, numeral and react-hook-form
